title: 第9章 淮南封王，再问金丹
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
仙凡殊途……

    这四个字，如同四座大山，狠狠地压在了嬴政的心头。

    他明白了。

    彻底明白了。

    他追求了一辈子的东西，从一开始，就与他无缘。

    他所做的一切，不过是一场镜花水月的徒劳。

    他脸上的血色，彻底褪去，变得一片死灰。

    那双曾经睥睨天下的眼睛，失去了所有的光彩，变得黯然失色。

    “原来……是这样……”

    “原来……是这样……”

    他喃喃自语，痴了。

    良久，他忽然笑了。

    那笑声，充满了悲凉，充满了不甘，但更多的，是英雄末路的豪迈。

    “好！好一个仙凡殊途！”

    “既然朕不能长生，那朕，就要这大秦，万世不朽！”

    惊人的气势，从他那衰败的身体里，重新爆发出来。

    他不再纠结于个人的生死。

    他要用自己最后的时间，为他一手缔造的帝国，铸就一道永恒的屏障！

    他看着顾长青，眼神重新变得锐利。

    “长青，朕，快要死了。”

    “朕死之后，大秦必乱。以你的本事，自保无虞。”

    “朕只有一个请求。”

    “看在朕与你君臣一场，看在朕倾尽国力助你求道的份上，将来，若华夏有难，社稷倾覆，希望你能……出手一次。”

    这是始皇帝，最后的托付。

    顾长青看着他，看着这位即将逝去的千古一帝，心中，也生出了复杂的感慨。

    他点了点头，郑重地说道：“我答应你。”

    得到了顾长青的承诺，嬴政放下了心中最后一块大石。

    他眼中的光芒，渐渐熄灭，整个人陷入了深度的昏迷。

    但所有人都知道，这位帝王的生命，已经走到了尽头。

    咸阳宫的气氛，变得无比压抑。

    赵高开始频繁地出入李斯的府邸，两个在历史上留下浓重一笔的权臣，开始了他们最后的密谋。

    而顾长青，则被客气地“请”回了上卿府，府外的卫兵，增加了数倍。

    他成了整个咸阳城，最特殊的囚徒。

    对此，顾长青毫不在意。

    他每日在密室中静坐，神识却笼罩着整个咸阳，冷眼旁观着这场即将到来的政治风暴。

    他知道，嬴政一死，这个他亲手参与建立的庞大帝国，将会在极短的时间内，走向崩溃。

    他要做的，不是去挽救。

    而是为了实现始皇帝最后一个目标。

    始皇帝倾尽全力助他。

    那么，他便要还始皇帝一个万世仙朝。

    数日后，一个消息，从咸阳宫传出。

    始皇帝陛下，于东巡途中，在沙丘平台，龙驭上宾。

    消息一出，天下震动。

    紧接着，第二道诏书发出。

    废长子扶苏，立十八子胡亥为二世皇帝。

    并赐死扶苏与大将军蒙恬。

    李斯与赵高，终究还是走出了那一步。

    整个大秦的命运，就此被彻底改写。……

    当始皇帝的死讯，真正被确认的那一刻。

    身在上卿府密室中的顾长青，猛地睁开了眼睛。

    他感觉到，无比宏大、磅礴、充满了无尽威严与不甘的意志，从咸阳宫的方向，冲天而起！

    那是……

    始皇帝的龙魂！

    寻常人死后，魂魄浑浑噩噩，七日之内，便会消散于天地之间，或入轮回。

    但嬴政不同。

    他是一统六合的始皇帝，他身上的龙气与意志，强大到了一个匪夷所思的地步。

    即便是肉身死亡，他的神魂，也未在第一时间消散！
content_en:
Different paths between immortals and mortals...

    These four words were like four mountains, pressing hard on Ying Zheng's heart.

    He got it.

    Totally understand.

    What he has been pursuing all his life has eluded him from the beginning.

    Everything he did was just in vain.

    The color on his face completely faded and turned into a dead gray.

    Those eyes that once looked down upon the world lost all their luster and became eclipsed.

    "So...that's it..."

    "So...that's it..."

    He muttered to himself, crazy.

    After a long time, he suddenly smiled.

    That laughter was full of sadness and unwillingness, but more importantly, it was the heroism of a hero at the end of his life.

    "Okay! What a different path to immortality!"

    "Since I can't live forever, then I want this Great Qin to be immortal for eternity!"

    Astonishing momentum burst out again from his decayed body.

    He is no longer obsessed with personal life and death.

    He will use his last time to build an eternal barrier for the empire he created!

    He looked at Gu Changqing, his eyes becoming sharp again.

    "Evergreen, I'm going to die soon."

    "After my death, the Qin Dynasty will be in chaos. Use your ability to protect yourself."

    "I have only one request."

    "For the sake of my fight with you and your ministers, for the sake of my devoting all my national strength to help you seek enlightenment, in the future, if China is in trouble and the country is overturned, I hope you can... take action once."

    This is the final entrustment of the First Emperor.

    Gu Changqing looked at him, looking at the soon-to-be-passed emperor of all ages, with complicated emotions in his heart.

    He nodded and said solemnly: "I promise you."

    After receiving Gu Changqing's promise, Ying Zheng let go of the last big stone in his heart.

    The light in his eyes gradually went out, and he fell into a deep coma.

    But everyone knew that the emperor's life had come to an end.

    The atmosphere in Xianyang Palace became extremely depressing.

    Zhao Gao began to frequent Li Si's mansion, and the two powerful officials who left a strong mark on history began their final conspiracy.

    Gu Changqing, on the other hand, was politely "invited" back to Shangqing's Mansion, and the number of guards outside the mansion increased several times.

    He became the most special prisoner in the entire Xianyang City.

    Gu Changqing didn't care at all.

    He sat quietly in the secret room every day, but his consciousness enveloped the entire Xianyang, watching the coming political storm with cold eyes.

    He knew that once Ying Zheng died, the huge empire he had personally helped to establish would collapse in a very short period of time.

    What he wants to do is not to save.

    But to achieve the last goal of the First Emperor.

    The First Emperor tried his best to help him.

    Then, he would give the First Emperor an immortal dynasty for all eternity.

    A few days later, a piece of news came from Xianyang Palace.

    His Majesty the First Emperor, on his eastward patrol, was riding a dragon on the platform of a sand dune.

    As soon as the news came out, the world was shocked.

    Immediately afterwards, the second edict was issued.

    The eldest son Fusu was deposed and the eighteenth son Hu Hai was made the second emperor.

    He also granted death to Fusu and General Meng Tian.

    Li Si and Zhao Gao finally took that step.

    The fate of the entire Great Qin was completely rewritten. …

    The moment when the news of the First Emperor's death was truly confirmed.

    Gu Changqing, who was in the secret room of Shangqing Mansion, suddenly opened his eyes.

    He felt that something extremely majestic, majestic, and full of endless majesty and unwilling will soared into the sky from the direction of Xianyang Palace!

    That's...

    The Dragon Soul of the First Emperor!

    After ordinary people die, their souls are in a state of confusion. Within seven days, they will dissipate between heaven and earth, or enter reincarnation.

    But Ying Zheng is different.

    He was the First Emperor who unified the world, and the dragon energy and will in him were incredibly powerful.

    Even after his physical death, his spirit did not dissipate immediately!
